title: The 4 Best Portable Tire Inflators Under $80
h1: The 4 Best Portable Tire Inflators Under $80
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for portable tire inflators under $80, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at portable tire inflators under $80 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Kensun AC/DC Rapid Performance Digital Tire Inflator
products.blurb: Key specs: Dual power: 12V DC car socket and 110V AC wall outlet, 120W solid metal motor, Backlit digital gauge in PSI, BAR, and KPA.
strengths: AC/DC dual power is the clearest capability jump over bare-bones budget inflators
Metal motor construction outlasts plastic-geared budget units under repeated use
limitations: Not rated for anything beyond car, bike, and everyday SUV tires
AC cord connection is a recurring complaint in long-term owner reports
Slower on larger tires than a purpose-built compressor like the VIAIR 400P
features: Dual power: 12V DC car socket and 110V AC wall outlet
120W solid metal motor
Backlit digital gauge in PSI, BAR, and KPA
Auto shut-off at a preset pressure
Carry case included

products.name: EPAuto 12V DC Portable Air Compressor
products.blurb: Key specs: Digital gauge in PSI, KPA, BAR, and KG/CM2, Auto shut-off at a preset target pressure, Built-in LED flashlight.
strengths: Over 55,000 Amazon ratings, the largest reliability sample size in this category
Auto shut-off and a digital gauge match pricier competitors on core features
limitations: 12V-only, no AC or battery power option
Not rated for truck tires even at this budget tier
10-minute duty cycle, shorter than the Kensun or DEWALT
features: Digital gauge in PSI, KPA, BAR, and KG/CM2
Auto shut-off at a preset target pressure
Built-in LED flashlight
12V DC cigarette lighter plug
Rated for car, bike, and midsize SUV tires

products.name: DEWALT DCC020IB 20V MAX Tire Inflator
products.blurb: Key specs: Runs on 20V MAX battery, 12V DC, or 110V AC, Automatic shut-off at a set PSI, Screw-on Schrader chuck.
limitations: Requires an existing or separately purchased 20V MAX battery to use cordless mode
Bulkier to store than the dedicated inflators in this list

products.name: VIAIR 400P Portable Compressor Kit
products.blurb: Key specs: 150 PSI maximum pressure, 33% duty cycle at 20 minutes continuous run, IP54 dust and water resistance rating.
strengths: Rated for tires up to 35 inches, well beyond this tier's typical car-and-SUV limit
IP54 sealing outlasts unsealed budget and mid-tier inflators in harsh conditions
limitations: Overkill for buyers who only need car or midsize SUV tire coverage
Bulkier storage footprint than every other inflator in this list
